responsibility: This header provides the core target macros, ABI/storage-layout definitions, register naming, assembler formatting rules, builtins, symbol flags, and generic machine configuration for the H8/300 port. It defines CPU-selection macros, endian and alignment properties, pointer and type sizes, stack and return-address conventions, asm output hooks and directives, pragma registration, and numerous target constants that the compiler and companion files use to interpret the H8 architecture independently of any specific OS variant.
same_name_distinction: Unlike h8300.cc's runtime hook implementations, h8300.md's RTL patterns, and h8300.opt's option table, this file is the central target configuration header: it supplies preprocessor macros, ABI/layout constants, register/assembler naming, and declarations that parameterize the H8 port for the rest of the backend.
